body:
Are there any tokens you would like to see listed in Edge? Please share those with us using the link below! ❤️

Click Here to Submit Token Request Form

Edge will review this token and add it to the default assets in the app for full functionality.

Note: You may also add your own custom tokens in the app yourself to be able to trade and see the balance. See this article for help adding custom tokens
